finding.text: Only 3 of the 12 red scripts are touched (new-session, swallow, settings). chat-sent, debug-tab, deltas, earlier, in-place, reconnect, stall, dictation-bar and refresh are untouched in the diff and the log has no stated reason for any of them (the session log shows the pause, but not a per-script "left because" line, which the closing report asks for).

`core/Test/browser-scripts.mjs`: settings is still `"red"` with its `why` ("delay 0.5 s: 3 prompts sent") although `test/settings.mjs` was edited. The log says the 3 s case still sends 2 prompts, so it is half-done. Neither flip it nor leave the stale `why` (it now describes a fixed case); update the `why` to the open 3 s case.

`test/swallow.mjs:45-50` was changed so the card is placed while its first line is still the bubble's last, and the raw counts were lowered (5/4 to 4/3). That is a rewrite, so the requirements ask for a quote of the readme, doc or commit that changed this behaviour ("late card placements stay put"). The diff names it only in a comment and the session log has no quoted proof that the old script was stale.

`ux/Dictate/chat.js` (the `reset()` line near 375, and the `epoch` guards) changes behaviour, but the doc edit in `doc/chat.md` is one long sentence inside an already huge paragraph. The new `epoch` / `panel.reset()` rule is not in `ux/Dictate/readme.md`, and the fresh-worktree finding ("gitignored ai/tasks.json and page-work.json are absent, so A5 saw 404s") is recorded only in the session log. It belongs in the Dictate test doc.

The task folder cannot be continued cold. There is no `task.jsonl`, though the requirements demand findings as `log` lines and review answers there; everything is in `session.jsonl`, which also holds three ledger "ended without landing" lines. A fresh agent cannot tell which of the 12 are done, which are paused (the live-Servex pause at 00:50), or what to do next. Add one status log line with the green/red list, the pause reason, and the next script.

`chat.js` epoch fix: `reset()` clears the panel only when `watching === null`. If a session was already attached, `attach()` still does the clear on change. This is sound, but nothing tests the case of a late `Session.resume` join landing after reset, so only the `Session.start` path is proven by `new-session.mjs`.

`test/settings.mjs:30`: ignoring any `say` that has a `kind` hides diagnostic lines from the count. This is correct per `ext/Chat/v2/report.js`, but a script that asserts the diagnostic is filed as a log line would now need its own stub.

The simplest reading of the new-session fix is right (an epoch counter, about 6 lines). A promise-cancel or a `starting` identity check would be about the same size, so there is nothing simpler to ask for.
